component.name: VoxCut
component.summary: Automatically remove silences from audio and video

description.p: VoxCut automatically detects and removes the silent parts of your audio and video files, so you no longer have to cut every pause and breath by hand. It is built for podcasts, interviews, lectures and other spoken-word recordings.
Everything runs locally on your computer — your files are never uploaded.

ul.li: Works fully offline, no account required
Supports MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG, MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM and more
Adjustable silence threshold and voice margin
Optional XML/EDL timeline export for Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve

description.p: VoxCut is free for files up to 500 MB with three exports per day. A paid upgrade removes these limits and adds batch processing.
